title: Expose homework completion and grading through Lesson Context transport
verify: Learning Progress resolves the single class-scoped homework item for the authorized lesson: no item yields null, one item yields that item, and multiple items fail closed with ambiguous-homework-selection.

The existing Lesson Context projection exposes the provider-owned homework item and permitted class-visible completion statuses without grades; personal context retains the selected student's completion beside the private grade.

FT-005-AC-001: named /lesson-context actions let Admin or the assigned Teacher create the missing item from authorized lesson material, let only the session Student complete it, and expose the permitted class-visible status.
FT-005-AC-002: named /lesson-context actions let only Admin or the assigned Teacher record α, β, γ, or F for an authorized class student while keeping grades out of shared completion data.

Create proof submits no authoritative homeworkId, proves the persisted ID is a non-empty server-generated opaque value rather than a forged client value, and proves independently created items in distinct authorized class fixtures receive distinct IDs; a repeat-create submission leaves the item count and existing ID unchanged.

Focused provider and route tests prove invalid, forged, cross-center, unassigned, and wrong-role actions leave Learning Progress state unchanged; the route has no direct database writes and /api/lesson-context remains GET-only.

Every W37 probe uses isolated or disposable state, records state before and after rejected and repeated actions, safely reruns, closes its database/session resources, and removes only its exact temporary database and sidecars with a cleanup receipt.

evidence: Fresh verifier-owned isolated probe passed 1 file / 1 test and observed Student A completion in Student B's shared Lesson Context, grade-free shared completion data, corresponding personal grade visibility, private-target denial, provider selection, server-generated distinct IDs, repeat-action equality, accepted grades, and ambiguity fail-closed behavior.

The same disposable probe recorded state-before/state-after equality for forged, wrong-role, unassigned, cross-class, cross-center, and invalid-grade actions; source checks confirmed no route Learning Progress table access and no POST export in /api/lesson-context.

Fresh npm run check, npm run build, DATABASE_URL=:memory: npm run test (76 files / 260 tests), and git diff --check all exited 0. All probe fixtures used :memory: SQLite, closed resources in afterEach, and created no filesystem sidecars.

Attempt 1 RED, Attempt 2 executor GREEN/cleanup, and the prior semantic-fail report remain supporting evidence; no execute receipt was reused as independent proof and task lifecycle remains in_progress.
Fresh independent T3 semantic verification found no admitted finding or operator question and confirmed the accepted REQ-009 / REQ-014 / FT-005-AC-001 / FT-005-AC-002 claim set.

Attempt 2 source review and semantic checks confirmed Student A completion is visible to Student B through the authorized shared Lesson Context, while shared grades, personal targets, cross-class access, Learning Progress ownership, and GET-only API boundaries remain protected.
The semantic protocol contains exactly one SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass; Attempt 1 semantic-fail remains preserved as historical correction evidence.

purpose: Close the server-side Lesson Context gap for the existing Learning Progress homework, completion, and grade facts.
success_outcome: The protected Lesson Context route can server-render the provider-owned class-scoped homework/completion projection and accept server-authorized create, complete, and grade actions without adding a lesson relation, mutation API, or direct persistence bypass.
anti_goals: Do not add a lesson_id relation, migration, second homework source, or consumer-owned homework mapping.
Do not expose grades in the shared Student/Parent completion projection.
Do not add attendance, payment, or unrelated route behavior.
constraints: Learning Progress remains the only owner and writer of homework, completion, grade, and class-scoped homework selection facts.
The route consumes the provider-selected item and existing provider commands; it does not accept or invent homeworkId authority.
All route actions use the session actor and server-resolved center, class, lesson, role, and student scope; browser selectors remain untrusted.
Existing attendance, payment, material, API, database, and unrelated Lesson Context behavior remains unchanged.
invariants: A shared completion projection contains no grade fields.
A denied or invalid action writes no homework, completion, or grade state.
Repeated create submission cannot create a second class-scoped homework item.
Create persists a server-generated opaque ID, never a client-supplied ID; distinct new class items receive distinct IDs.
No consumer accepts or derives homeworkId.
verification_targets: FT-005-AC-001 and FT-005-AC-002 transport path: isolated tests cover Admin/assigned Teacher creation and grading, Student completion, permitted completion visibility, accepted grade scale, corresponding student/linked-family access, and unrelated Student/unlinked-Parent denial.
Provider and route source review confirms Learning Progress owns selection and writes, Lesson Context only adapts, and /api/lesson-context remains GET-only.
Rejected role, scope, action, and selector cases compare state before and after and are safe to rerun against isolated state.

stop_conditions: Stop and route to /spec-redesign if the accepted class-scoped model requires a lesson relation, schema/migration, new public edge, or ownership change.
Stop if the route cannot delegate through the existing Learning Progress public commands without trusting client authority or writing persistence directly.
